verdict.rationale: Munito AI's docs list "prompt caching" among its capabilities, so the product claims the feature itself. That is the only mention: nothing describes how caching works, which models support it, or whether cached tokens are cheaper or faster. Missing for 10: documentation of cache mechanics (automatic vs. explicit cache-control, prefix rules, TTL), cached-token pricing or discounts, latency figures, per-model support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
